title: Omino Tree Canonical Representation
description: A rows x cols grid with dashed interior lines. Some cells hold a number; gray arrows sit on interior edges, each pointing from its start cell into the orthogonally adjacent end cell. The solver draws walls to divide the board into blocks: a number is its block's size; the two cells of an arrow are in different blocks, and the end block is the start block in the same orientation plus one cell; every block holds at least one arrow start or end.

numbers.description: rows x cols; 0 = no number, n > 0 = the size of the cell's block.

arrows.description: Arrows by start cell and the direction to the end cell, which must be inside the grid. At most one arrow per edge.
